shared_elements: rounded/arched upper edge of an inscribed slab
horizontal registers of script-like signs separated by ruled dividing lines
small pictorial signs (glyph-like forms) repeated in rows
justification: Both surfaces present a round-topped inscribed panel covered with horizontal ruled registers of small pictorial sign-forms, and both include a conspicuous large oval enclosing marks, a fairly specific shared convention of writing arranged in banded lines with framed name-signs. The biggest difference in content is that A carries a full figural lunette scene, adoring human figures, a rayed disc, and a laden offering table above the text, none of which is present on B, which shows only sign registers.
